what: World-space radiance cascades for diffuse GI in 3D (web/shaders/cascades3d), ROADMAP P6 raw-hall stage, and H150's traced-segment remedy in the flatland path
written: 2026-11-06, before any 3D code ran and before any measurement

method.frame: pixel = emission + albedo / pi x (E_sun + E_gi). E_sun is the shadowed sun as in lighting model 2. E_gi (sky and every interreflection) comes from the cascades. The primary hit is the pixel-centre ray, as in the path tracer and pt-error.
method.reference: raw_native_cli gi-reference: the repository's path tracer (interface v2, pure Lambert, ambient sky 0.2, sun irradiance pi) on the same triangles, 8 bounces. Two seeds give its own noise.
method.metric: pt-error's: relative RMSE in luminance over pixels both cover, plus bias. A 95% tile-bootstrap interval (32 x 32 tiles).
method.no_gi_baseline: the same pipeline with E_gi = pi x sky x cosine-weighted sky visibility (256 rays a pixel), which is lighting model 2 with more sky rays
method.timing: GPU timestamps around the GI passes only (world cascades, screen probes, gather); the primary hit and the sun ray are timed separately and reported beside it. Median and 5th to 95th percentile of 50 frames; three separate runs for repeatability.

p1_planted_furnace.what: a closed box with an inner box, albedo 128/255 and emission 1 everywhere, no sun and no sky; the exact answer after B bounces is sum_{k=0..B} rho^k
p1_planted_furnace.bound: cascades against the closed form: relative RMSE at most 1e-4 on the CPU (float64) and at most 2e-3 on the GPU; the metric on the closed form plus 1% of its mean reads 0.0100 +- 0.0001; the path tracer against the closed form within 3 x its own noise
p1_planted_furnace.prediction: holds: every weight in the method is normalised, so a uniform field is reproduced exactly

p2_parity.what: GPU (f32) against the float64 CPU reference on small scenes, all fix modes and screen-probe strides
p2_parity.bound: relative RMSE at most 2e-3 per case on SwiftShader and on the RTX 4090
p2_parity.prediction: holds, with a few pixels flipping where a ray grazes an edge

e1_hall_error.what: raw-hall nave against the 8-bounce path trace at 512 x 320 (the size of lighting model 2's 0.43) and at 1920 x 1080
e1_hall_error.bound: relative RMSE at most 0.30 (ROADMAP P6: at least 30% below 0.43) for the shipped setting
e1_hall_error.prediction: 0.10 to 0.25; the no-GI baseline in this pipeline reads 0.38 to 0.48, which also checks that this pipeline agrees with pt-error's

t1_hall_time.what: the GI passes for raw-hall nave at 1920 x 1080 on the RTX 4090 (WebGPU in Chrome, D3D12)
t1_hall_time.bound: median under 6.0 ms for the shipped setting, the same setting as e1
t1_hall_time.prediction: uncertain: 4 to 12 ms; the world cascades cost the same at any resolution, the screen probes scale with pixels over stride squared

k1_leak_kill.what: leak scene (two rooms, a 4 cm partition, sun through a skylight in room A), door variant, camera in room B
k1_leak_kill.bound: kill if the cascades' relative RMSE in room B exceeds the no-GI baseline's

l1_closed_room.what: the leak scene with the door shut: room B's exact radiance is 0
l1_closed_room.bound: with either fix, room B's mean luminance at most 1% of room A's view mean; without fix recorded
l1_closed_room.prediction: no fix leaks several percent; the probe-visibility fix and the full fix stay under 1%

c1_cost_cuts.what: screen-probe stride 1, 2, 4, 8 (cascade 0 at lower density) and fix none, probe visibility (one segment a probe pair) and full (one ray a probe, direction and neighbour)
c1_cost_cuts.prediction: stride 4 within 10% of stride 1's error at a quarter of the screen-probe cost; probe visibility within 2x of the full fix's leak at under 1/8 of its fix cost

h150_traced_segment.what: flatland glass scene: inside a band of width D around the glass circle, fluence = w x traced + (1 - w) x cascades, w = 1 - d / D; traced = rays bent exactly for a path length S, then the cascade read at the virtual probe end - dir x t_c
h150_traced_segment.bound: the 0 to 2 px band's error over the image mean falls by at least 30% against the plain cascades at the same plan; cost recorded
h150_traced_segment.kill: the band error falls by less than 10%
h150_traced_segment.prediction: falls by 40 to 70%; the band cost scales with the band's pixel count
